summary: Worx chain sizes here come from two documents that do not describe the same saws. The WG322 / WG323 manual specifies a 10 inch, 0.043 inch, 40-link loop. Oregon's selection guide specifies the older WG300 family, the WG309, and the JawSaw, at different gauges and pitches. A 10 inch Worx saw can be either document.
